description: Defines the class 'FieldItemList' which manages a list of field items for an entity in Drupal, including methods for access control, default values, validation, and comparison.

classes.name: FieldItemList
classes.description: Represents a list of field items for an entity, providing methods for managing, accessing, and validating field data within Drupal.

methods.name: createItem
methods.description: Creates a new field item at a specified offset with an optional value.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the entity associated with this field item list.

methods.name: setLangcode
methods.description: Sets the language code for the field values.

methods.name: getLangcode
methods.description: Gets the language code of the field values.

methods.name: getFieldDefinition
methods.description: Returns the field definition object.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieves the settings for the field.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Retrieves a specific setting by name.

methods.name: filterEmptyItems
methods.description: Removes empty items from the list.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value(s) of the field items.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Accesses a property of the first field item.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Sets a property of the first field item, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Checks if a property exists on the first field item.

methods.name: __unset
methods.description: Unsets a property on the first field item.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks access permissions for a given operation.

methods.name: defaultAccess
methods.description: Returns default access permission (allowed).

methods.name: applyDefaultValue
methods.description: Applies default values to the field items.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Performs actions before saving, such as filtering empty items.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Performs actions after saving.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the field items.

methods.name: deleteRevision
methods.description: Deletes a revision of the field items.

methods.name: delegateMethod
methods.description: Calls a specified method on each field item.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Returns a renderable array for viewing the field.

methods.name: generateSampleItems
methods.description: Generates sample field items.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns validation constraints for the field.

methods.name: defaultValuesForm
methods.description: Builds a form element for default values.

methods.name: defaultValuesFormValidate
methods.description: Validates the default value form input.

methods.name: defaultValuesFormSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the default value form.

methods.name: processDefaultValue
methods.description: Processes default value for a field.

methods.name: defaultValueWidget
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the widget used for default value input.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Compares this list with another for equality.

methods.name: hasAffectingChanges
methods.description: Checks if there are changes affecting the field compared to original.
